text: Retention policy: collect only parts explicitly named by the retired previous manifest, after a successful new manifest swap and clean journal reset; verify all three generations first. Current/previous parts remain. Any journals/ entry pins all generations because historical journal base digests are not a complete manifest index. Unknown/corrupt references defer; unrelated files, inputs, run artifacts and older unindexed orphans are never guessed at. Cleanup failures are separate from successful save. This deliberately conservative policy bounds ordinary future save growth and preserves archived recovery. Implementation and fault/mutation qualification in progress; no closure yet.
